# `aitbc agent verify-identity`

Verify an agent's identity using a verifier address on the blockchain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent verify-identity [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | Agent id string (e.g. agent_a1b2c3d4) — not the numeric identity_id |
| `--verifier-address` | text | — | yes | The Verifier address. |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet signing the verification (must control --verifier-address; default: $AITBC_DEFAULT_WALLET) — required: the node rejects unsigned verifies |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent verify-identity --agent-id <agent_id> --verifier-address <verifier_address>
```
